sources.publicConcepts: Untrusted data can flow from sources to sinks through assignments and calls. Configurable sanitizers affect flow. Exact source and sanitizer models distinguish call results from nested expressions; richer side-effect, control and cross-function analyses have separate contracts.

A vulnerability report can expose an ordered source-to-sink path with source locations. Product workflows also provide issue context and remediation guidance; those hosted workflows are not implemented here.

provenance: Public documentation concepts only. No upstream implementation or test-suite files opened, and no documentation source examples copied. All native API policies, fixtures and tests are original; these observations do not establish product compatibility, execution parity or security accuracy.

nativePolicy.models: Explicit disjoint exact static call names for source returns, sanitizer returns, conservative argument-to-return propagators and zero-based sink arguments. Every simple function parameter is untrusted. Calls do not mutate caller bindings in these opaque models.
nativePolicy.scopes: Synchronous named top-level function declarations, optionally exported, are analyzed independently as possible entry points. Straight-line declarations, assignment and eager expressions only. Scope inventory precedes tracing, including after return; execution tracing stops at return. No closure or local-call resolution. Bindings require simple ASCII names; escaped/Unicode spellings refuse analysis to prevent model shadowing.
nativePolicy.paths: One deterministic immutable trace per origin/value, preserving copies, overwrites, assignment-expression steps and ordered sink locations. Nested arguments evaluate before sanitizers/sources; sanitizers only clear returned values. Type assertions preserve taint; void evaluates its operand but returns clean.
nativePolicy.evidence: JSON dataFlow with UTF-16 ranges, text steps and SARIF codeFlows/threadFlows. Discard a rule's prior findings on unsupported analysis; emit incomplete evidence and refuse a passing baseline.
nativePolicy.limits: 25 rules, 32 call names per role and sinks per rule, argument indexes 0..31; 100,000 shared per-file work units, 128 expression levels and trace locations, 64 origins/value, 512 bindings/scope, 1000 paths/rule; existing source/parser/report bounds also apply.
nativePolicy.remaining: Branches, loops, short-circuit control flow, dynamic/unknown calls, imports, classes, heap/objects/arrays, closures, async, interprocedural/cross-file/framework/type semantics, built-in vulnerability catalog, full documented cases and comparative precision/recall remain unsupported.

refusals: example/command-flow: Taint analysis: scope needs unique simple ASCII bindings without shadowing call models
